plugins.description: Fourteen Claude skills for day trading: a chart scanner, a smart-money level mapper, an ITH / LTH market-structure reader, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager, an order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts, an earnings analyst, a Pelosi tracker and a trade journal that scores every trade against its plan.
